In this project all LLM output is untrusted and goes through `normalize()` in [extraction.py](/private/var/folders/rt/wqlkzryn0l9c58c4lz0j9v700000gn/T/memoryos-bench/20261101-012109/cb-extraction-rules-without-2/careerbricks/backend/app/services/extraction.py:202), which never raises. A new field should follow the same pattern:

1. Clean first (`_clean`): `bool`/non-string -> `None`, numbers -> `str`, collapse whitespace, drop placeholder words (`N/A`, `unknown`, `not specified`, etc.), clip to `max_len`.
2. Ground in posting: `job_posting_id` must appear verbatim, `work_mode` needs evidence regex match, `company/role/location` need a word match. Invented values -> `None`.
3. Canonicalize: `work_mode` -> `onsite|remote|hybrid`, unknowns (`flexible`, `contract`) -> `None`.
4. Self-repair, don't trust garble: bad `job_posting_id` is re-read from `Job ID:/Req#/Ref:` label; bad pay is re-read from posting. If no repair, `None`.
5. Strict formats: `deadline` must be real `YYYY-MM-DD`, `link` must be `http(s)` present in text, no `javascript:`.
